post.description:
Retrieve from the caller's ready documents, then stream a cited answer.

Retrieval runs before the stream opens, so its failures are ordinary 503/500
responses. The stream sends `sources` (numbered chunks), `token` events as the model
writes, `citations` (only numbers that map to a sent source; others are dropped), and
`done` with the cleaned answer. Nothing retrieved means a refusal with no LLM call. A
provider failure mid-answer, a busy server (all answer slots taken) or an answer past
its total deadline ends the stream with an `error` event. The answer is plain
text: links in it are reported in `done.external_links`, never fetched (ADR-0007).

200.description: Server-Sent Events: sources, token (repeated), citations, done; or error. Each data line is JSON. Payload schemas: SourcesEvent, TokenEvent, CitationsEvent, DoneEvent, ErrorEvent

post.description:
Add a user turn and stream the answer (guide 6.3, ADR-0009).

404 unless the caller owns the conversation. The user message is saved before anything
else can fail. Earlier turns are trimmed to HISTORY_MAX_TOKENS; on any turn after the
first, the question is rewritten for retrieval (REWRITE_MODE, default rule). The
assistant message is saved when the stream ends: the cleaned answer, or the partial
text with truncated=true after an error or a disconnect.

post.description:
Dense + sparse search, fused by RRF and reranked. Scoped to the caller's tenant.

mode (dense|sparse|hybrid), rerank, candidates and expand (none|neighbors) each
default to the matching setting when omitted. document_ids, when given, restricts
the search to those documents - a document the caller's tenant doesn't own simply
matches nothing, rather than erroring. Only chunks of ready documents are returned.
debug=true (admins only; 403 otherwise) adds the retrieval trace: per-stage timing
and the ranked ids from each stage.
